title: Tailoring, Softened

image.alt: Model in a dark brown tailored suit, seen from the side

excerpt: Classic tailoring loses its stiffness. A closer look at the fabrics and fits that make a blazer feel like knitwear.

body.text: Tailoring used to mean stiffness. Now it can mean a blazer that feels closer to a cardigan: same clean line, far more give.
Wool with a little stretch keeps its shape through a day of sitting, walking and carrying a bag. Cashmere blends bring the softness without losing the edge.
Pair a tailored blazer with a ribbed knit and a wide trouser. Each piece is simple alone; together they build a shape.
Comfort is not the opposite of polish. It is what lets polish last all day.
